title: iPhone Duo review: a fun device with a cool matte inner display, but the cover display is too small, it is heavy and bulky, the cameras are OK, and it gets hot (The Verge)
summary: The Verge: iPhone Duo review: a fun device with a cool matte inner display, but the cover display is too small, it is heavy and bulky, the cameras are OK, and it gets hot — The iPhone Duo is the riskiest Apple product in years. It's a huge rethink of what an iPhone is and could be …
